text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. Plan your tasks, set a clear schedule, and start early instead of rushing at the last minute. Prioritization is also important, so focus on the most urgent and important work first. Scope management matters too: if a task is too big, break it into smaller steps or agree on what is essential. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early so they can help. With these habits, deadlines become less stressful and more manageable.
